user.title: Deadband Filter Sensor
user.description: Create a filtered sensor that updates only on significant changes or heartbeat timeout, reducing database writes while preserving Long-Term Statistics (LTS).

data_description.source: The high-frequency numeric source sensor to filter.
data_description.name: Custom friendly name. Defaults to source name with 'Filtered' suffix.
data_description.delta: Minimum absolute value change required to publish an update (e.g. 40 W).
data_description.percentage: Minimum percentage change required to publish an update (e.g. 5 for 5%).
data_description.heartbeat: Maximum time elapsed before forcing a state publication (e.g. 5 minutes).
data_description.precision: Optional number of decimal places to round values to.

error.no_filter_criteria: At least one of delta, percentage, or heartbeat must be configured.
error.invalid_delta: Delta must be a positive number.
error.invalid_percentage: Percentage must be a positive number.
error.invalid_heartbeat: Heartbeat must be a positive duration.

abort.already_configured: A deadband filter for this source sensor is already configured.
